name: qa_head_reviews
description: Fetch the reviews that RULED ON this head SHA. Returns one JSON object with four fields: `head_sha` (echoed back), `head_first_seen_at` (the first instant the forge attested this SHA exists — MIN of its check_suites' created_at), `reviews` (an array of {author, state, submitted_at, carries_verdict_line}, empty when no review ever ruled on this head), and `dropped_predating_head` (how many reviews the tool refused). A review qualifies only when its commit_id is exactly this head AND it was submitted at or after head_first_seen_at: `commit_id` alone names the head the forge attributes a review to today, which a force-push can rewrite (mika#2939, measured on #2920 — a review submitted at 07:16:49Z carried a commit_id created at 12:14Z). The tool applies both halves of that filter itself; do not re-derive it. Review bodies are NOT returned; carries_verdict_line is the fact that a body carries a `VERDICT: pass` or `VERDICT: block[...]` line. This is the only read that names the head a review ruled on: `reviewDecision` and `mergeStateStatus` are PR-level states that survive a force-push (mika#2934). A missing or malformed field — including a head with no readable check_suite — is an error, never an empty `reviews` array. `dropped_predating_head` is an INSTRUMENT, never a reason to skip: a non-zero count means the evidence is absent, so you review.

repo.description: owner/name, exactly as the webhook names it (e.g. senara-solutions/mika)

pr.description: the PR number the check_suite names

head_sha.description: the check_suite's head SHA — 40 lowercase hex characters, already in hand from the event
